Amumu.combo: Go in on a target with an isolation mark after Amumu Q Bandage Toss and Amumu R Curse of the Sad Mummy are down. Break vision in a brush or with Kha'Zix R Void Assault to activate Kha'Zix P Unseen Threat, then use Kha'Zix Q Taste Their Fear → empowered basic attack → Kha'Zix W Void Spike as soon as Kha'Zix E Leap lands. If the fight continues, break vision again with Kha'Zix R Void Assault, move to the side, then follow with an empowered basic attack → Kha'Zix Q Taste Their Fear.
Amumu.watch: If Amumu Q Bandage Toss hits you, it stuns you and lets Amumu close the distance, so dodge it with a minion or jungle monster between you. Amumu R Curse of the Sad Mummy stuns nearby enemies, so when his R is available, avoid grouping with allies or fighting in narrow paths. After being caught, you also keep taking damage from Amumu W Despair, which deals damage based on your maximum health, so don’t stay near him for long.
Amumu.escape: The window to go in opens just after Amumu Q Bandage Toss and Amumu R Curse of the Sad Mummy are down. Amumu has no skill that lets him create distance on his own, so close the gap with Kha'Zix E Leap then. If crowd control is still available, save Kha'Zix E Leap, break vision with Kha'Zix R Void Assault, and look for a place to escape.
Amumu.build: Amumu E Tantrum reduces physical damage taken, so if you have to fight Amumu, build armor penetration first. Build magic resistance against Amumu’s magic damage, and avoid stacking only health because of Amumu W Despair.
Amumu.teamfight: Wait on the flank or behind the enemy until Amumu Q Bandage Toss and Amumu R Curse of the Sad Mummy are down. Then go in on an isolated backline damage dealer who has split from the formation, and use Kha'Zix R Void Assault to break vision, exit, and go back in. Don’t spend a long time attacking Amumu head-on or stand with allies inside the range of Amumu R Curse of the Sad Mummy.
Amumu.fight: Look for a fight when Amumu is isolated from jungle monsters and has an isolation mark. If he has no mark, don’t force a fight with Kha'Zix Q Taste Their Fear. Once Amumu Q Bandage Toss and Amumu R Curse of the Sad Mummy are down, close in with Kha'Zix E Leap and deal quick damage. Don’t fight near Amumu for long because of Amumu E Tantrum and Amumu W Despair.
Amumu.laning: When ganking, set up behind a wall and check whether the target is away from minions and has an isolation mark. If you can walk in, save Kha'Zix E Leap for chasing or escaping.
Amumu.phase: Mid game, when you have two or more evolutions, is a strong point for Kha'Zix, but check Amumu R Curse of the Sad Mummy before fighting. If the enemy team groups up late game, there will be fewer isolated targets, so look for enemies who have split off.

Ivern.laning: Early on, focus on clearing camps and warding Ivern's jungle to read his farming path instead of forcing fights. Look for an opportunity when Ivern comes to a camp alone and the isolation marker appears. Don't casually walk beside a newly created Ivern W Brushmaker. For ganks, look for an angle where the target is separated from minions, and save Kha'Zix E Leap for chasing or escaping.
Ivern.fight: After Ivern Q Rootcaller is down and Ivern E Triggerseed bursts, look for a target with the isolation marker. Combine Kha'Zix E Leap's landing damage with Kha'Zix Q Taste Their Fear, then use Kha'Zix R Void Assault to break vision and reactivate Kha'Zix P Unseen Threat. Instead of chasing Ivern deep, catch the moment an ally he was protecting becomes separated.
Ivern.build: It's more dangerous when your allies join after Ivern Q Rootcaller's root and Ivern R Daisy!'s knock-up than Ivern's damage itself, so prioritize tenacity. If you build resistance against Ivern's ability damage, choose magic resistance over armor. Also consider movement speed to get out of telegraphed areas.
Ivern.combo: After Ivern Q Rootcaller is down and Ivern E Triggerseed on the target bursts, use a bush or Kha'Zix R Void Assault to break vision and activate Kha'Zix P Unseen Threat. Check for the isolation marker, close in with Kha'Zix E Leap, and immediately upon landing use Kha'Zix Q Taste Their Fear → empowered basic attack → Kha'Zix W Void Spike. If the fight continues, use Kha'Zix R Void Assault to break vision again and move to the side, then follow up with an empowered basic attack → Kha'Zix Q Taste Their Fear.
Ivern.escape: The moment after you bait Ivern Q Rootcaller is a window to close the gap with Kha'Zix E Leap. If Ivern E Triggerseed is already on the target, wait for the shield to burst, and check for the knock-up threat from Ivern R Daisy! before engaging.
Ivern.phase: In the late game, the enemy has fewer isolated targets when grouped up, so create an angle to catch a separated opponent.
Ivern.teamfight: Wait on a flank or behind, then engage after Ivern Q Rootcaller and Ivern R Daisy!'s crowd control are down. When Ivern E Triggerseed bursts and a backline damage dealer separates from the formation and gets the isolation marker, go for that target. After engaging, use Kha'Zix R Void Assault to break vision, disengage, and then re-engage.

Belveth.teamfight: Don’t go in from the front; wait on the flank for Bel'Veth W Above and Below to be used, then target someone separated from the formation. After engaging, break vision with Kha'Zix R Void Assault and disengage before going in again. If you lose an ally and Void Coral drops, back off before Bel'Veth picks it up. Delay the teamfight while Bel'Veth is transformed by Bel'Veth R Endless Banquet.
Belveth.build: Bel'Veth Q Void Surge and E Royal Maelstrom deal physical damage, so build armor first. If healing from Bel'Veth R Endless Banquet offsets your assassination damage, fit Executioner's Calling between core items. Bel'Veth R Endless Banquet’s true damage can’t be reduced by resistances, so survive with a larger health pool.
Belveth.combo: When Bel'Veth W Above and Below is down and you see an isolation mark, break vision with a brush or Kha'Zix R Void Assault to activate Kha'Zix P Unseen Threat. Immediately after Kha'Zix E Leap lands, use Kha'Zix Q Taste Their Fear → empowered basic attack → Kha'Zix W Void Spike, and don’t use another action between Kha'Zix E Leap and Kha'Zix Q Taste Their Fear. If the fight continues, attack again with Kha'Zix R Void Assault → move to the side → empowered basic attack → Kha'Zix Q Taste Their Fear.
Belveth.escape: Don’t engage just because you see Bel'Veth use Bel'Veth Q Void Surge once. Dodge Bel'Veth W Above and Below, then engage with Kha'Zix E Leap right after Bel'Veth Q Void Surge is used and before that mobility spell comes back up. When disengaging, move to the side to avoid Bel'Veth W Above and Below, and break vision with Kha'Zix R Void Assault.
Belveth.fight: Look for Bel'Veth when she has an isolation mark, but don’t use your burst into Bel'Veth E Royal Maelstrom. After dodging Bel'Veth W Above and Below to the side, close the distance with Kha'Zix E Leap before Bel'Veth Q Void Surge comes back up. During the fight, break vision with Kha'Zix R Void Assault to use Kha'Zix P Unseen Threat again.
Belveth.laning: For ganks, target someone away from the wave and slow them with Kha'Zix W Void Spike, then save Kha'Zix E Leap to chase or disengage.
Belveth.phase: In the late game, Bel'Veth’s permanent stacks build up and grouped enemies leave Kha'Zix fewer isolation opportunities, so focus on finding targets who split off.
Belveth.watch: Bel'Veth W Above and Below knocks you up and resets Bel'Veth Q Void Surge’s cooldown, so turn to the side to dodge when she closes in. Bel'Veth E Royal Maelstrom greatly reduces the damage she takes while it spins, so save Kha'Zix Q Taste Their Fear until it ends.

Evelynn.watch: If you see the mark from Evelynn W Allure, back away before the charm completes and warn your allies. When your health is low, watch out for the heavy damage from Evelynn R Last Caress and don’t stay in areas without vision.
Evelynn.fight: Check for an isolation mark to make sure there are no allied units or jungle monsters around Evelynn before deciding to fight. Avoid the charm from Evelynn W Allure, and after Evelynn R Last Caress is down, close the gap with Kha'Zix E Leap and look for an isolated target. During the fight, break vision with Kha'Zix R Void Assault to refresh Kha'Zix P Unseen Threat and attack again.
Evelynn.teamfight: Don’t go in head-on; wait for an isolated target on the flank or behind the enemy. Go in after Evelynn W Allure’s charm is down, and if Evelynn R Last Caress is also down, take the opportunity to target Evelynn. After going in, use Kha'Zix R Void Assault to break vision and go back in. Have allied backline damage dealers who are watching out for Evelynn stand inside an area with vision.
Evelynn.build: If healing from Evelynn P Demon Shade offsets your assassination damage, buy Executioner's Calling between your core items. Build magic resistance first against Evelynn’s main damage. Evelynn W Allure reduces magic resistance, so it’s also important to back away before its mark completes.
Evelynn.combo: Activate Kha'Zix P Unseen Threat where vision is broken, then close in on an isolated Evelynn with Kha'Zix E Leap. Attack as soon as you land with Kha'Zix Q Taste Their Fear → empowered basic attack → Kha'Zix W Void Spike. If you can continue fighting, follow with Kha'Zix R Void Assault → move to the side → empowered basic attack → Kha'Zix Q Taste Their Fear.
Evelynn.escape: Avoid the charm from Evelynn W Allure, then look for an opportunity to go in. If only Evelynn E Whiplash is down, she can escape with Evelynn R Last Caress, so look for a window when R is down too. Then close the gap with Kha'Zix E Leap, and during the fight use Kha'Zix R Void Assault to break vision and escape or re-enter.
Evelynn.laning: Place vision beside the jungle camps Evelynn uses to start fights so you can track her path. When ganking, look for an angle where the enemy is away from minions, and save Kha'Zix E Leap for chasing or escaping.
Evelynn.phase: If the enemy team groups up late game and it’s hard to find isolated targets, focus on finding an angle to catch Evelynn or another enemy who has split off.

Lillia.laning: When you don’t know Lillia’s location, don’t walk straight through jungle entrances or narrow river passages. When ganking, look for the enemy to be away from allied minions; walk in and slow with Kha'Zix W Void Spike, then save Kha'Zix E Leap to chase or disengage.
Lillia.teamfight: Don’t approach from the front; wait on a flank for Lillia to separate from the formation. Lillia has low armor and needs to stay close to deal sustained damage, so it helps to save one of your allies’ immobilizing crowd control abilities for her. After entering, use Kha'Zix R Void Assault to break vision and disengage, then target an isolated enemy again.
Lillia.fight: Dodge Lillia’s attacks before she can build movement speed stacks, and look for the moment an isolation mark appears. After Lillia W Watch Out! Eep! is used, you can close the distance with Kha'Zix E Leap. Lillia’s armor is relatively low, so Kha'Zix’s physical damage is effective, but don’t force an engage on a target without an isolation mark.
Lillia.build: Lillia P Dream-Laden Bough healing can offset assassination damage, so fit Executioner's Calling between core items. Build magic resistance first against Lillia’s main damage, and consider armor too if you need to withstand her basic attack damage. Resistances do not apply to the true damage from Lillia Q Blooming Blows, and stacking health alone increases the max-health-based damage from Lillia P Dream-Laden Bough.
Lillia.combo: If Lillia is isolated and has used Lillia W Watch Out! Eep!, use a bush or Kha'Zix R Void Assault to break vision and prepare Kha'Zix P Unseen Threat. Close in with Kha'Zix E Leap and, immediately on landing, attack in this order: Kha'Zix Q Taste Their Fear → empowered basic attack → Kha'Zix W Void Spike. If you can keep fighting, use Kha'Zix R Void Assault to break vision again, move to the side, then follow with an empowered basic attack → Kha'Zix Q Taste Their Fear.
Lillia.escape: Lillia W Watch Out! Eep! is a mobility tool, so right after she uses it is your window to go in with Kha'Zix E Leap. If Lillia R Lilting Lullaby puts you into drowsy, move to safety while you can still move. Don’t insist on chasing while Lillia’s ability hits have built up her movement speed stacks.
Lillia.phase: Later, when the enemy groups up, isolated targets are harder to find, so focus on finding an angle to catch Lillia when she is split off.
Lillia.watch: Lillia Q Blooming Blows and Lillia E Swirlseed build her movement speed stacks when they hit you and also meet the sleep condition for Lillia R Lilting Lullaby, so don’t let them hit you. Be especially wary of Lillia E Swirlseed in narrow passages. When you see the cast animation for Lillia W Watch Out! Eep!, move to the side to avoid the center.

Nidalee.watch: Nidalee Q Javelin Toss deals more damage the farther it travels, so step out of its path and, where possible, keep minions or your allied frontline between you and Nidalee. Avoid Nidalee W Bushwhack too, so you can fight without a Hunt mark. If you are hit by a spear, save Kha'Zix E Leap for when Nidalee uses Nidalee Q Takedown after closing in with Nidalee W Pounce.
Nidalee.phase: Mid game, when Kha'Zix has two or more evolutions, is his strongest phase, so look for a Nidalee who is split off. Later, when the enemy groups up, isolated targets are harder to find, so set up an angle to catch an enemy who is split off. The information alone doesn’t establish which of Nidalee or Kha'Zix is stronger at each stage.
Nidalee.build: Nidalee E Primal Surge heals, so fit Executioner's Calling between core items. Build magic resistance against Nidalee’s damage. Even with resistances, dodging Nidalee Q Javelin Toss comes first.
Nidalee.combo: When Nidalee W Pounce is down and an isolation mark is visible, activate Kha'Zix P Unseen Threat from a spot out of vision, then close in with Kha'Zix E Leap. Immediately on landing, use Kha'Zix Q Taste Their Fear → empowered basic attack → Kha'Zix W Void Spike, in that order. If the fight continues, follow with Kha'Zix R Void Assault → move to the side → empowered basic attack → Kha'Zix Q Taste Their Fear.
Nidalee.escape: Right after you make Nidalee use Nidalee W Pounce is your chance to go in with Kha'Zix E Leap. Nidalee has no crowd control, so dodge her spear and trap and confirm the isolation mark before engaging. When you need to escape, use Kha'Zix R Void Assault to break vision.
Nidalee.fight: Close the distance with Kha'Zix E Leap right after you make Nidalee use Nidalee W Pounce. Confirm an isolation mark with no units around Nidalee, then deal damage with Kha'Zix Q Taste Their Fear. During the fight, use Kha'Zix R Void Assault to break vision and reactivate Kha'Zix P Unseen Threat.
Nidalee.laning: Watch for Nidalee W Bushwhack at jungle entrances and in river passages; check with a Control Ward or an area ability before entering. When ganking, look for the enemy to be away from the wave and isolated, and save Kha'Zix E Leap to chase or disengage.
Nidalee.teamfight: Don’t approach from the front; wait on a flank or behind for Nidalee to separate from the formation. Remember where Nidalee came out to throw Nidalee Q Javelin Toss, then confirm the isolation mark and whether Nidalee W Pounce has been used before engaging. After entering, use Kha'Zix R Void Assault to break vision and look for an angle to go in again.

RekSai.teamfight: Don’t go in from the front; wait from the side or behind for Rek'Sai W Burrow / Un-burrow’s knock-up to go down. Engage when an enemy backline damage dealer strays from formation and becomes isolated. After attacking, use Kha'Zix R Void Assault to break vision and create another opening to go in.
RekSai.fight: Before fighting, check whether Rek'Sai is isolated, with no allied units or jungle monsters nearby. Avoid the knock-up from Rek'Sai W Burrow / Un-burrow; if her mobility is also down, close the gap with Kha'Zix E Leap. When Rek'Sai tries to heal by Burrowing, don’t give her space; keep attacking.
RekSai.laning: Early on, avoid giving up kills to Rek'Sai’s ganks: don’t walk alone through areas without vision, and don’t push your lane too aggressively. If you see the entrance to Rek'Sai E Furious Bite / Tunnel near a lane or in your jungle, walk over it to destroy it. When ganking, target enemies away from their minion wave, and save Kha'Zix E Leap to chase or escape.
RekSai.build: Prioritize armor against Rek'Sai’s main damage. Armor cannot reduce the true damage from Rek'Sai E Furious Bite / Tunnel, and Rek'Sai R Void Rush scales with maximum health, so be careful about stacking health alone. If healing from Rek'Sai P Fury of the Xer'Sai prevents an assassination, buy Executioner's Calling between core items.
RekSai.combo: When Rek'Sai’s knock-up and mobility are down and the isolation mark is visible, activate Kha'Zix P Unseen Threat from an area without vision, then close in with Kha'Zix E Leap. As soon as you land, attack in this order: Kha'Zix Q Taste Their Fear → empowered basic attack → Kha'Zix W Void Spike. If you can keep fighting, use Kha'Zix R Void Assault to break vision, move sideways, then follow up with an empowered basic attack → Kha'Zix Q Taste Their Fear.
RekSai.escape: The window to engage is after Rek'Sai W Burrow / Un-burrow’s knock-up is down. If only Rek'Sai E Furious Bite / Tunnel is down, she can escape with Rek'Sai R Void Rush, so look for a window before Rek'Sai R Void Rush is back up and engage with Kha'Zix E Leap.
RekSai.phase: Early on, Rek'Sai can gain an advantage easily through ganks, so Kha'Zix should focus on camps and vision instead of forcing fights. In the late game, if the enemy team groups up and it’s hard to isolate a target, look for enemies who have split off instead of taking a direct team fight.
RekSai.watch: Rek'Sai W Burrow / Un-burrow knocks Kha'Zix up when she emerges from Burrow, so when you see her go underground, avoid walls and narrow paths and move toward open ground. Use Kha'Zix E Leap as she emerges to dodge the knock-up. Stay close to allies after Rek'Sai damages you, since Rek'Sai R Void Rush can follow up.

Viego.teamfight: Don’t go in from the front; wait on the flank or behind for an isolated target. Engage after Viego W Spectral Maw is down, then break vision with Kha'Zix R Void Assault to disengage before going in again. If an ally is killed in front of Viego, don’t continue fighting near that spot. If Viego has possessed someone, create distance until he returns to his original body.
Viego.laning: In a side lane, look for when the enemy steps ahead of the wave and becomes isolated. For ganks, look for an angle to cross over with Kha'Zix E Leap from behind a wall. Don’t push the lane toward the direction where Viego E Harrowed Path is visible; place a Control Ward or go around the path.
Viego.build: Build armor first to reduce the main damage from Viego Q Blade of the Ruined King and Viego R Heartbreaker. If Viego P Sovereign's Domination and Viego Q Blade of the Ruined King's healing prevent an assassination, fit Executioner's Calling between core items.
Viego.combo: Check for an isolation mark, then break vision with a brush or Kha'Zix R Void Assault to activate Kha'Zix P Unseen Threat. Close in with Kha'Zix E Leap, then immediately on landing use Kha'Zix Q Taste Their Fear → empowered basic attack → Kha'Zix W Void Spike. If the fight continues, break vision again with Kha'Zix R Void Assault, move to the side, then follow with an empowered basic attack → Kha'Zix Q Taste Their Fear.
Viego.escape: Consider engaging when Viego W Spectral Maw is down and he can’t stun you. Viego can also escape with Viego R Heartbreaker, so close the distance with Kha'Zix E Leap during a window when that ability is down or before it comes back up. After engaging, break vision with Kha'Zix R Void Assault and disengage.
Viego.fight: When Viego is clearing a camp alone or becomes isolated away from the wave, deal quick burst damage with Kha'Zix Q Taste Their Fear. Dodge Viego W Spectral Maw to the side, and if Viego R Heartbreaker is not back up yet, close the distance with Kha'Zix E Leap. Avoid fights where Viego could get a takedown.
Viego.phase: In the late game, grouped enemies leave fewer isolated targets, so create opportunities to catch a split-off Viego or another target.
Viego.watch: Viego W Spectral Maw stuns for longer the more it is charged, so dodge to the side when you see him charging. When Viego E Harrowed Path covers terrain, watch for Viego camouflaged inside it and go around the path. If your health is low, fall back because Viego R Heartbreaker can target you.

Brand.teamfight: Keep your distance from allies to avoid Brand E Conflagration spreading and Brand R Pyroclasm bouncing between you. Don’t go in head-on; wait on the flank until Brand Q Sear is down and Brand has split from the formation, then check for an isolation mark. After going in, use Kha'Zix R Void Assault to break vision, exit, and go back in.
Brand.build: Build magic resistance before armor against Brand’s damage. Brand P Blaze deals damage based on maximum health, so avoid stacking only health. Movement speed is also useful for getting out of the way of telegraphed attacks.
Brand.combo: As soon as Kha'Zix E Leap lands, use Kha'Zix Q Taste Their Fear → empowered basic attack → Kha'Zix W Void Spike. If the fight continues, break vision again with Kha'Zix R Void Assault, move to the side, then follow with an empowered basic attack → Kha'Zix Q Taste Their Fear.
Brand.escape: Brand has no mobility, so the moment Brand W Pillar of Flame is down is your chance to go in. If you’re ablaze, dodge the stun from Brand Q Sear first, then go in with Kha'Zix E Leap. After going in, you can use Kha'Zix R Void Assault to break vision and escape or attack again.
Brand.fight: After Brand W Pillar of Flame is down, check for an isolation mark and close the gap with Kha'Zix E Leap. Brand has no mobility and low armor, so once you’re on him, Kha'Zix Q Taste Their Fear and empowered basic attacks are good for dealing damage. If you’re ablaze, dodge Brand Q Sear before going in.
Brand.laning: When Brand is near a burning minion, watch out for Brand E Conflagration spreading. Look for a gank angle when he is away from the wave and has an isolation mark. If there is vision at the river entrance, wait behind a wall, then cross it with Kha'Zix E Leap.
Brand.phase: If Brand groups with his allies late game, there will be fewer isolated targets, so look for someone who has split off.
Brand.watch: Dodge Brand W Pillar of Flame or Brand Q Sear first to make it easier to prevent stacks of Brand P Blaze. If you’re ablaze, Brand Q Sear can stun you, so get out of the projectile’s path or hide behind a minion. If you see Brand R Pyroclasm being cast, move away from your allies.

Fiddlesticks.teamfight: Fiddlesticks W Bountiful Harvest, Fiddlesticks E Reap, and Fiddlesticks R Crowstorm are area-of-effect abilities, so spread out from your team and don't group in narrow paths without vision. Wait on a flank, then engage when Fiddlesticks Q Terrify is down and a backline target is isolated. After attacking, use Kha'Zix R Void Assault to break vision and look for a chance to re-engage.
Fiddlesticks.build: Fiddlesticks W Bountiful Harvest can heal enough to offset your burst, so buy Executioner's Calling between core items. Build magic resistance rather than armor to defend against Fiddlesticks' damage.
Fiddlesticks.combo: Look for Fiddlesticks with an isolation marker from a position where vision is cut off.
Fiddlesticks.escape: The window to engage is when Fiddlesticks' mobility tool, Fiddlesticks R Crowstorm, is down and Fiddlesticks Q Terrify is also down. When Fiddlesticks R Crowstorm starts, use Kha'Zix E Leap to leave its range and wait out its duration.
Fiddlesticks.fight: When Fiddlesticks R Crowstorm is down, check for the isolation marker and use Kha'Zix E Leap to close the gap. Don't force an engage while Fiddlesticks Q Terrify is still available. When Fiddlesticks W Bountiful Harvest starts, don't stay in place and take its damage.
Fiddlesticks.laning: When you can read Fiddlesticks' pathing and he's clearing camps alone, check for the isolation marker before engaging, or take camps on the opposite side and leave. Keep the brush behind lane warded, and don't walk past a stationary Fiddlesticks P A Harmless Scarecrow without checking it.
Fiddlesticks.phase: In the late game, it's hard to find an isolated target when the enemy team groups up, so look for a separated Fiddlesticks or another target.
Fiddlesticks.watch: Be careful of being silenced by Fiddlesticks E Reap and hit by Fiddlesticks R Crowstorm while feared by Fiddlesticks Q Terrify. When you see Fiddlesticks R Crowstorm channeling, use Kha'Zix E Leap to get out of range. If Fiddlesticks has been out of sight for a while, avoid bushes you have no vision of and narrow entry paths.

Jax.teamfight: Don't engage head-on; wait for an isolated opponent on a flank or behind. If Jax engages while Jax E Counter Strike is active, don't group up nearby; get out of stun range and wait for its duration to end. Engage after Jax E Counter Strike is down, then use Kha'Zix R Void Assault to break vision, disengage, and re-engage.
Jax.combo: After Jax E Counter Strike ends, if the isolation marker is visible, use a bush or Kha'Zix R Void Assault to break vision and prepare Kha'Zix P Unseen Threat. If you close in with Kha'Zix E Leap, immediately upon landing use Kha'Zix Q Taste Their Fear → empowered basic attack → Kha'Zix W Void Spike. If the fight continues, use Kha'Zix R Void Assault to break vision again and move to the side, then follow up with an empowered basic attack → Kha'Zix Q Taste Their Fear.
Jax.escape: When Jax E Counter Strike is active, save Kha'Zix E Leap so you can use it to get out of stun range.
Jax.fight: Trade when Jax E Counter Strike is down and the isolation marker is visible. Stop basic attacking and create distance while Counter Strike is active. If you can re-engage, focus on ability damage, such as Kha'Zix Q Taste Their Fear.
Jax.laning: Early on, spend time clearing camps and securing vision instead of forcing fights. Path toward the side where Jax steps ahead of the wave and gets the isolation marker.
Jax.phase: The mid game, when you've stacked two or more evolutions, is Kha'Zix's peak. In the late game, it's hard to find isolated targets when the enemy groups up, so look for a separated opponent.
Jax.watch: Jax E Counter Strike dodges basic attacks and, when recast, deals area damage based on your max health and stuns you.

Nocturne.laning: Maintain vision around the river and jungle entrances, and position yourself to retreat before Nocturne R Paranoia is activated. Check for an isolation mark and approach when Nocturne is clearing a camp alone or steps ahead of the wave in a side lane. For ganks, set up an angle from beyond a wall, but don’t expect isolation damage if Nocturne is near allied minions.
Nocturne.teamfight: When Nocturne R Paranoia darkens the screen, move toward your allies to avoid becoming an isolated target. Kha'Zix should wait on the flank or behind, then engage when Nocturne E Unspeakable Horror is down and an enemy backline damage dealer is separated. After engaging, break vision with Kha'Zix R Void Assault to disengage before going in again.
Nocturne.watch: If you’re hit by Nocturne Q Duskbringer, Nocturne can quickly approach along its trail, so don’t run straight away; turn toward an ally or turret. Nocturne W Shroud of Darkness blocks one ability and doubles his attack speed when it blocks one, so don’t use Kha'Zix Q Taste Their Fear while the shield is active. If Nocturne E Unspeakable Horror connects, you’ll be feared, so save Kha'Zix E Leap to create distance and break the tether. When Nocturne R Paranoia darkens the screen, don’t stay alone; move toward your allies immediately.
Nocturne.build: Nocturne P Umbra Blades’ healing can offset your assassination damage, so buy Executioner's Calling between core items. Build armor first against Nocturne’s main damage from P Umbra Blades, Q Duskbringer, and R Paranoia.
Nocturne.combo: If Nocturne W Shroud of Darkness is active, strip it first with Kha'Zix W Void Spike. Check for an isolation mark, then break vision with a brush or Kha'Zix R Void Assault. Immediately after Kha'Zix E Leap lands, use Q Taste Their Fear → empowered basic attack. Then break vision again with Kha'Zix R Void Assault, move to the side, and continue attacking with an empowered basic attack → Q Taste Their Fear.
Nocturne.escape: Use Kha'Zix E Leap to engage Nocturne with an isolation mark while Nocturne E Unspeakable Horror is down and R Paranoia is unavailable. If Nocturne E Unspeakable Horror starts connecting, use Kha'Zix E Leap to create distance and avoid the fear.
Nocturne.fight: When Nocturne is alone and an isolation mark appears, deal damage with Kha'Zix Q Taste Their Fear. If Nocturne W Shroud of Darkness is active, strip the shield first with Kha'Zix W Void Spike before engaging. If Nocturne E Unspeakable Horror is still available, save Kha'Zix E Leap so you can use it to break the fear tether.
Nocturne.phase: In the late game, Nocturne grouping with his allies makes it hard to find isolated targets, so look for enemies who split off.

Rengar.teamfight: Don’t go in from the front; wait for an isolated target from the side or behind. Engage after Rengar E Bola Strike is down, and use Kha'Zix R Void Assault to break vision, leave, and then go back in. When watching for Rengar R Thrill of the Hunt, stay close to allies and within vision so Rengar is revealed before he leaps.
Rengar.build: Since Rengar W Battle Roar can heal through Kha'Zix’s burst, buy Executioner's Calling between core items. Prioritize armor against Rengar’s main damage.
Rengar.combo: When going in on an isolated Rengar, break vision in brush or with Kha'Zix R Void Assault to activate Kha'Zix P Unseen Threat. After dodging Rengar E Bola Strike, close in with Kha'Zix E Leap and, as soon as you land, attack in this order: Kha'Zix Q Taste Their Fear → empowered basic attack → Kha'Zix W Void Spike. If Rengar W Battle Roar is down, attack again with Kha'Zix R Void Assault → move sideways → empowered basic attack → Kha'Zix Q Taste Their Fear.
Rengar.escape: After dodging Rengar E Bola Strike, engage with Kha'Zix E Leap. Rengar has no ability to create distance on his own, so check for the isolation mark and close in while his resource bar is empty and Rengar W Battle Roar is also down.
Rengar.fight: Trade when Rengar’s resource bar is empty and Rengar W Battle Roar is down. Check for the isolation mark before going in to maximize Kha'Zix Q Taste Their Fear’s damage. During the fight, use Kha'Zix R Void Assault to break vision and refresh Kha'Zix P Unseen Threat.
Rengar.laning: Avoid paths beside brush when Rengar is out of sight, and use Control Wards to gain vision in brush. Before ganking, check for the isolation mark and wave position, and save Kha'Zix E Leap to chase or escape.
Rengar.phase: In the late game, it’s hard to find isolated targets when the enemy team groups up, so look for enemies who have split off.
Rengar.watch: Rengar P Unseen Predator lets him leap from brush and build up his resource, so avoid walking beside brush when Rengar is out of sight. If his resource bar is full, watch for the root from Rengar E Bola Strike and the crowd control cleanse from Rengar W Battle Roar, and delay trades. Don’t roam alone while injured when Rengar R Thrill of the Hunt is active.

Warwick.fight: Check for an isolation mark with no allied units near Warwick, then deal damage with Kha'Zix Q Taste Their Fear. If Warwick E Primal Howl is active, back off and close in again after the fear triggers. Warwick’s healing becomes stronger at low health too, so don’t force a finish based only on his health bar.
Warwick.teamfight: Don’t go in from the front; wait on the flank or behind for an isolated damage dealer. Engage after Warwick E Primal Howl and R Infinite Duress are down, then break vision with Kha'Zix R Void Assault to disengage before going in again. If an ally is caught by Warwick R Infinite Duress and has no way to cleanse it, switch your focus to saving that ally.
Warwick.build: Build magic resistance first against Warwick’s main ability damage, and get armor as well against his basic attacks. Warwick P Eternal Hunger, Q Jaws of the Beast, and R Infinite Duress heal him, so fit Executioner's Calling between core items to apply Grievous Wounds. If you need to cleanse Warwick R Infinite Duress directly, choose Quicksilver Sash or Mercurial Scimitar.
Warwick.combo: Activate Kha'Zix P Unseen Threat where vision is broken, check for an isolation mark, then close in with Kha'Zix E Leap. Immediately on landing, use Kha'Zix Q Taste Their Fear → empowered basic attack → Kha'Zix W Void Spike to overlap the landing and Q damage. If the fight continues, break vision with Kha'Zix R Void Assault, move to the side, then attack again with an empowered basic attack → Q.
Warwick.escape: Look for an engage window after Warwick E Primal Howl’s fear triggers and before Warwick R Infinite Duress comes back up. If only Warwick Q Jaws of the Beast is down, he can still move with R, so don’t immediately use Kha'Zix E Leap. After engaging, break vision with Kha'Zix R Void Assault to disengage or go in again.
Warwick.laning: For ganks, look for an angle where the target is isolated away from the wave, and save Kha'Zix E Leap to chase or disengage if you can walk in. If your health falls below half, Warwick W Blood Hunt reveals your location, so recall even if you have to give up some farm.
Warwick.phase: In the late game, when grouped enemies make it harder to find isolated targets, focus on catching enemies who split off instead of taking a front to back teamfight.
Warwick.watch: When Warwick E Primal Howl is active, he takes reduced damage and can fear you, so don’t use your burst; back off. The fear can be triggered early by recasting, so it’s dangerous to wait beside Warwick and simply count its duration. Warwick R Infinite Duress suppresses you, and the higher Warwick’s movement speed, the farther away he can land it from.

LeeSin.phase: Lee Sin is strong in early duels, so Kha'Zix should avoid forcing fights and focus on camps and vision. Later, when the enemy groups up, isolated targets are harder to find, so target an enemy who is split off.
LeeSin.teamfight: Don’t approach from the front; wait on a flank or behind for Lee Sin R Dragon's Rage to be used. Engage when an enemy backline damage dealer is separated from the formation and isolated. After entering, use Kha'Zix R Void Assault to break vision as you disengage and re-enter.
LeeSin.build: Build armor first against the damage from Lee Sin Q Sonic Wave / Resonating Strike and Lee Sin R Dragon's Rage. If Lee Sin’s basic attacks and attack speed are a problem, consider an option that lowers attack speed.
LeeSin.combo: Immediately on landing, use Kha'Zix Q Taste Their Fear → empowered basic attack → Kha'Zix W Void Spike, in that order. If you can keep fighting, use Kha'Zix R Void Assault to break vision, then follow with an empowered basic attack and Kha'Zix Q Taste Their Fear.
LeeSin.escape: The window to engage is after Lee Sin Q Sonic Wave / Resonating Strike misses or is used, before it can be used again. Check whether Lee Sin W Safeguard / Iron Will is still available to escape with, and in team fights, engage after Lee Sin R Dragon's Rage is down.
LeeSin.fight: Target Lee Sin after confirming the isolation mark, and close the distance with Kha'Zix E Leap before Lee Sin Q Sonic Wave / Resonating Strike comes back up. If Lee Sin W Safeguard / Iron Will is also down, focus your damage; during the fight, use Kha'Zix R Void Assault to break vision and reactivate Kha'Zix P Unseen Threat.
LeeSin.laning: If you encounter Lee Sin in the early jungle, avoid dueling and spend time on camps and vision. When ganking, check for the enemy’s isolation mark, and save Kha'Zix E Leap so you can chase or escape.
LeeSin.watch: Lee Sin can cross a wall with Lee Sin W Safeguard / Iron Will from beyond your vision, so keep your distance from walls.

Briar.teamfight: Don’t go in head-on. Wait on the flank or behind the enemy for Briar Q Head Rush, Briar W Blood Frenzy / Snack Attack, Briar E Chilling Scream, and Briar R Certain Death’s crowd control to be used. Briar W Blood Frenzy / Snack Attack chases the nearest enemy, so position behind your allied frontline and go in when a backline damage dealer is isolated. After attacking, use Kha'Zix R Void Assault to break vision and look for an angle to go in again.
Briar.fight: Look for a moment when Briar is away from allied units or jungle monsters and has an isolation mark. If Briar Q Head Rush and Briar W Blood Frenzy / Snack Attack are still available, don’t go in first with Kha'Zix E Leap; wait until her mobility is down, then deal burst damage quickly.
Briar.build: Build armor first against the physical damage from Briar P Crimson Curse, Briar Q Head Rush, and Briar W Blood Frenzy / Snack Attack. If her healing prevents an assassination, fit Executioner's Calling between your core items.
Briar.combo: Break vision in a brush or with Kha'Zix R Void Assault to ready Kha'Zix P Unseen Threat. If the fight continues, break vision again with Kha'Zix R Void Assault, move to the side, then follow with an empowered basic attack → Kha'Zix Q Taste Their Fear.
Briar.escape: Don’t go in just because either Briar Q Head Rush or Briar W Blood Frenzy / Snack Attack is down. Close the gap with Kha'Zix E Leap after both dashes and the crowd control from Briar E Chilling Scream are down, especially if Briar R Certain Death won’t be back up yet.
Briar.laning: To counterattack Briar’s engage, push the lane and secure vision. When ganking, look for a moment when the enemy has split from the minion wave and becomes isolated.
Briar.phase: If the enemy team groups up late game, there will be fewer chances to find isolated targets, so wait on the flank for someone who has split off.
Briar.watch: Briar Q Head Rush dashes in, stuns, and reduces armor, so avoid trading right after it hits you. When Briar E Chilling Scream starts charging, move away from walls. If Briar R Certain Death hits you with its bloodstone, move toward your allies and fight back together.

Gragas.fight: When Gragas starts drinking with Gragas W Drunken Rage, hold your burst until its damage reduction ends. When Gragas has an isolation mark because there are no units allied to him nearby and Gragas E Body Slam is down, close the gap with Kha'Zix E Leap and use Kha'Zix Q Taste Their Fear. A deep chase risks getting hit by Gragas E Body Slam again, so only do it when you can finish him for sure.
Gragas.build: Include physical penetration to account for Gragas’s high armor. Gragas P Happy Hour’s healing can offset your assassination damage, so fit Executioner's Calling between your core items. Magic resistance is more effective than armor against Gragas’s damage, and build movement speed to get out of barrel range.
Gragas.combo: When Gragas E Body Slam is down and he has an isolation mark, break vision in a brush or with Kha'Zix R Void Assault to activate Kha'Zix P Unseen Threat. As soon as Kha'Zix E Leap lands, use Kha'Zix Q Taste Their Fear → empowered basic attack → Kha'Zix W Void Spike. Then use Kha'Zix R Void Assault → move to the side → empowered basic attack → Kha'Zix Q Taste Their Fear to deal passive damage again.
Gragas.escape: Gragas E Body Slam is his means of mobility, so the moment after you make him use it is your window to go in with Kha'Zix E Leap. In teamfights, go in after Gragas E Body Slam and Gragas R Explosive Cask are down. If you’re within the radius of Gragas Q Barrel Roll, get out first.
Gragas.laning: Early on, focus on camps and vision instead of forcing fights. If there is vision at the river entrance, look for an angle to cross from behind a wall with Kha'Zix E Leap.
Gragas.phase: Mid game, when you have two or more evolutions, look for an isolated Gragas or a backline target, but watch out for Gragas’s burst damage and formation disruption in the early and mid game. Gragas’s sustained damage weakens late game, but if the enemy team groups up, Kha'Zix will have fewer chances to find isolated targets, so look for someone who has split off.
Gragas.teamfight: Don’t try to endure while attacking Gragas head-on; wait on the flank or behind the enemy. Go in when Gragas E Body Slam and Gragas R Explosive Cask are down and a backline damage dealer has split from the formation. After going in, use Kha'Zix R Void Assault to break vision, exit, and go back in.
Gragas.watch: If you see Gragas Q Barrel Roll, leave its radius immediately. If Gragas E Body Slam hits you near the barrel, you can be knocked up and hit by the explosion as well. When Gragas R Explosive Cask is available, don’t stand somewhere it can knock you toward the enemy team or a turret.

Kayn.teamfight: Don't engage head-on; wait on a flank or behind for Kayn W Blade's Reach to be used. Engage when an enemy backline damage dealer separates from the formation and becomes isolated, then use Kha'Zix R Void Assault to break vision and repeat disengages and re-engages. An ally caught by Kayn R Umbral Trespass can't be helped during that time, so be ready for Kayn to emerge near the target.
Kayn.build: Build armor first to defend against the primary damage from Kayn Q Reaping Slash, W Blade's Reach, and R Umbral Trespass. If Kayn transforms into the Darkin Slayer and his healing prolongs the duel, build resistances first, then fit Executioner's Calling between core items. Since Kayn Q Reaping Slash deals damage based on your max health, avoid choices that add a lot of health alone.
Kayn.combo: When Kayn W Blade's Reach and Kayn R Umbral Trespass are down and the isolation marker is visible, use a bush or Kha'Zix R Void Assault to break vision and activate Kha'Zix P Unseen Threat. Close in with Kha'Zix E Leap and immediately upon landing use Kha'Zix Q Taste Their Fear → empowered basic attack → Kha'Zix W Void Spike. If Kayn survives and the fight continues, use Kha'Zix R Void Assault → move to the side → empowered basic attack → Kha'Zix Q Taste Their Fear to attack again.
Kayn.escape: Don't engage just because Kayn Q Reaping Slash is down. Dodge Kayn W Blade's Reach, then engage with Kha'Zix E Leap after Kayn R Umbral Trespass is also down and before his ultimate comes back up.
Kayn.fight: Check Kayn's transformation form and the isolation marker, and look for Kayn when there are no units nearby. After dodging Kayn W Blade's Reach, if Kayn R Umbral Trespass is also down, close the gap with Kha'Zix E Leap and deal burst damage quickly. If the fight continues, use Kha'Zix R Void Assault to break vision and reactivate Kha'Zix P Unseen Threat.
Kayn.laning: Pressure Kayn's jungle path before he transforms and force objectives, but don't give him early kills that speed up his transformation. For ganks, walk in and slow the target with Kha'Zix W Void Spike, saving Kha'Zix E Leap for chasing or escaping.
Kayn.phase: In the late game, when the enemy groups up and it's hard to find isolated targets, look for an angle to catch a separated Kayn or another target instead of joining the teamfight.
Kayn.watch: Kayn W Blade's Reach slows and knocks you airborne, and getting hit can lead into Kayn R Umbral Trespass, so avoid its line. Kayn Q Reaping Slash is a dash that deals damage based on your max health, so be careful about letting him approach. If a warning marker appears at the edge of a wall, Kayn is approaching with Kayn E Shadow Step; retreat toward your turret immediately.

MasterYi.teamfight: Don’t approach from the front; wait on a flank, and don’t leave one of your allies alone for Master Yi to get a chance at consecutive kills. Right after Master Yi Q Alpha Strike ends, target an isolated enemy in coordination with your allies’ immobilizing crowd control. Allies can interrupt Master Yi W Meditate with immobilizing crowd control, and after entering, use Kha'Zix R Void Assault to break vision and go back in.
MasterYi.build: Build health against the true damage from Master Yi E Wuju Style, and consider ways to lower attack speed too. If Master Yi W Meditate healing offsets your assassination damage, buy Executioner's Calling between core items.
MasterYi.combo: From a spot out of vision, activate Kha'Zix P Unseen Threat, then confirm the isolation mark after Master Yi Q Alpha Strike ends. Close in with Kha'Zix E Leap and, immediately on landing, use Kha'Zix Q Taste Their Fear → empowered basic attack → Kha'Zix W Void Spike, in that order. Then use Kha'Zix R Void Assault to break vision, move to the side, and attack again with an empowered basic attack → Kha'Zix Q Taste Their Fear.
MasterYi.escape: Right after Master Yi uses Master Yi Q Alpha Strike is your window to go in with Kha'Zix E Leap. While Master Yi R Highlander is active, don’t rely on the slow from Kha'Zix P Unseen Threat; use Kha'Zix R Void Assault to break vision or Kha'Zix E Leap to escape.
MasterYi.fight: Confirm the isolation mark before fighting. Make Master Yi use Master Yi Q Alpha Strike, then close the distance with Kha'Zix E Leap right after he lands and use Kha'Zix Q Taste Their Fear. If Master Yi R Highlander is active, don’t rely on slows; use Kha'Zix R Void Assault to break vision or Kha'Zix E Leap to manage distance.
MasterYi.laning: Right after Master Yi uses Master Yi Q Alpha Strike is your chance to close in with Kha'Zix E Leap. When ganking, check whether the enemy is separated from minions, and save Kha'Zix E Leap to chase or disengage.
MasterYi.phase: Master Yi is weak in the jungle early, but Kha'Zix should also avoid forcing fights before his first evolution and focus on camps and vision. Master Yi gets stronger as the game goes on, and the enemy grouping up reduces Kha'Zix’s chances to isolate a target, so later, set up an angle to catch someone split off.
MasterYi.watch: Master Yi can’t be targeted while casting Master Yi Q Alpha Strike, so use Kha'Zix Q Taste Their Fear immediately after he lands. Master Yi E Wuju Style adds true damage to his basic attacks, and slows don’t work while Master Yi R Highlander is active, so don’t stay and fight him for long.

Shaco.phase: Early on, watch for Shaco’s ganks and invades, avoid giving up kills, and secure vision and camps. In the late game, Shaco is weaker in solo fights, but if the enemy team groups up, it’s also harder for Kha'Zix to find isolated targets, so look for enemies who have split off.
Shaco.teamfight: Don’t go in from the front; wait for an isolated target from the side or behind. Right after Shaco appears with Shaco Q Deceive, focus the real Shaco with your allies, while watching for Shaco W Jack In The Box and the fear from Shaco R Hallucinate. After engaging, use Kha'Zix R Void Assault to break vision, leave, and then go back in.
Shaco.build: Prioritize magic resistance against Shaco W Jack In The Box, Shaco E Two-Shiv Poison, and Shaco R Hallucinate. Get enough health to avoid dropping into the health range where Shaco E Two-Shiv Poison deals more damage. Bring Control Wards and Oracle Lens to check paths without vision and areas around objectives.
Shaco.combo: When Shaco Q Deceive is down and the isolation mark appears, activate Kha'Zix P Unseen Threat out of sight and close in with Kha'Zix E Leap. As soon as you land, attack in this order: Kha'Zix Q Taste Their Fear → empowered basic attack → Kha'Zix W Void Spike. If you can keep fighting, use Kha'Zix R Void Assault to break vision, move sideways, then follow up with an empowered basic attack → Kha'Zix Q Taste Their Fear.
Shaco.escape: Right after you make Shaco use Shaco Q Deceive, he can’t immediately escape with the same ability, so you can close the gap with Kha'Zix E Leap. Before engaging, check whether Shaco W Jack In The Box and the fear from Shaco R Hallucinate are down, or whether you can avoid their area. If you’re in danger after engaging, use Kha'Zix R Void Assault to break vision and escape.
Shaco.fight: Target Shaco after Shaco Q Deceive is down and the isolation mark appears. Break vision to activate Kha'Zix P Unseen Threat before going in, and during the fight, use Kha'Zix R Void Assault to break vision again and follow up with empowered basic attacks and Kha'Zix Q Taste Their Fear. Avoid fighting where Shaco W Jack In The Box is placed.
Shaco.laning: If you can read Shaco’s pathing, take camps on the opposite side and leave. When ganking, look for an angle where the enemy is away from the wave, and save Kha'Zix E Leap to chase or escape.
Shaco.watch: Watch for Shaco W Jack In The Box in brush without vision and around objectives, and don’t start an objective from a spot where you could be feared. Shaco R Hallucinate’s clone dies faster than the real Shaco, but explodes and fears when it dies; use health bar reactions to identify the real one, and retreat if you kill the clone. When low on health, avoid paths without vision where you risk being hit by Shaco E Two-Shiv Poison.

Diana.teamfight: Keep your distance from allies based on your entry angle, and secure vision on the flank so several allies aren’t pulled in by Diana R Moonfall. Don’t go in head-on; wait until Diana R Moonfall is down and a backline damage dealer is separated and isolated, then go in. After attacking, break vision with Kha'Zix R Void Assault and re-enter.
Diana.build: The source does not specify a first purchase item. Prioritize magic resistance over armor against Diana’s damage. Movement speed also helps you get out of positions where Diana’s attacks are telegraphed.
Diana.combo: When Diana W Pale Cascade is down and you see an isolation mark, break vision in a brush or with Kha'Zix R Void Assault to activate Kha'Zix P Unseen Threat. Go in with Kha'Zix E Leap during the window when Diana E Lunar Rush is down, then attack as soon as you land with Kha'Zix Q Taste Their Fear → empowered basic attack → Kha'Zix W Void Spike. If the fight continues, break vision again with Kha'Zix R Void Assault, move to the side, then use an empowered basic attack and Kha'Zix Q Taste Their Fear.
Diana.escape: If Diana uses Diana E Lunar Rush first without Diana Q Crescent Strike, go in while she has no mobility to get back out. In teamfights, enter from the flank after Diana R Moonfall is down. If you’re marked by Diana Q Crescent Strike, don’t go in; create distance.
Diana.fight: Start a fight when the orbs and shield from Diana W Pale Cascade are down and you see an isolation mark. If Diana goes in first with Diana E Lunar Rush without Diana Q Crescent Strike, slow her with Kha'Zix P Unseen Threat and counterattack. If you’re hit by Diana Q Crescent Strike’s mark, don’t try to catch her; create distance with Kha'Zix R Void Assault.
Diana.laning: When ganking, path toward the side where the enemy is away from the wave and isolated, and set up from beyond a wall. Save Kha'Zix E Leap so you can follow Diana E Lunar Rush or escape.
Diana.phase: If the enemy team groups up late game and there are no isolated targets, create an angle to catch someone who has split off.
Diana.watch: Diana Q Crescent Strike curves through the air and leaves a mark, so dodge it sideways. If you’re hit by the mark, expect Diana E Lunar Rush to let her re-engage and create distance with Kha'Zix R Void Assault. Don’t fight close to Diana before the orbs and shield from Diana W Pale Cascade disappear.

Graves.teamfight: Don't engage head-on. Wait on a flank or behind for Graves or another damage dealer to separate from the formation. When the isolation marker appears, attack with Kha'Zix Q Taste Their Fear. After engaging, use Kha'Zix R Void Assault to break vision, disengage, and then re-engage. If the enemy groups up and isolation is hard to create, poke and slow them with evolved Kha'Zix W Void Spike.
Graves.build: Get Plated Steelcaps early and build armor first to defend against Graves' primary damage. Armor doesn't mitigate the magic damage from Graves W Smoke Screen, but it helps reduce his other primary damage.
Graves.combo: Check for Graves' isolation marker and use a bush or Kha'Zix R Void Assault to break vision and activate Kha'Zix P Unseen Threat. Close in with Kha'Zix E Leap and, immediately upon landing, attack in this order: Kha'Zix Q Taste Their Fear → empowered basic attack → Kha'Zix W Void Spike. If the fight continues, use Kha'Zix R Void Assault to move to the side and refresh your passive, then follow up with an empowered basic attack → Kha'Zix Q Taste Their Fear.
Graves.escape: Don't engage just because Graves E Quickdraw is down. Close the gap with Kha'Zix E Leap while Graves R Collateral Damage is still down and Graves E Quickdraw is also down. If you're inside Graves W Smoke Screen, get out of its area first, then engage again.
Graves.fight: Counterattack when Graves fires two shots and reloads. When defending, put an allied unit between you and Graves to block Graves P New Destiny's basic attacks. When attacking, check for the isolation marker before using Kha'Zix Q Taste Their Fear. Fight in open terrain rather than near walls where Graves Q End of the Line detonates immediately.
Graves.laning: Look for isolated moments, such as when Graves is clearing camps alone, but if you can read his pathing, taking camps on the opposite side and leaving is also worthwhile. For ganks, walk in and slow him with Kha'Zix W Void Spike, saving Kha'Zix E Leap for chasing or escaping.
Graves.phase: In the late game, Graves gets stronger with stacks, and it's hard to isolate targets when the enemy groups up, so look for a separated target.
Graves.watch: Graves Q End of the Line detonates immediately when it hits terrain, so don't fight with your back to a wall. If you're caught in Graves W Smoke Screen, take the shortest route out, then use Kha'Zix R Void Assault to break vision before approaching again. Graves E Quickdraw can build armor while creating distance, so don't chase too hard before he uses it.

Kindred.teamfight: Don’t approach from the front; wait on a flank and engage when Kindred is separated from the formation and the enemy’s targeted crowd control is down. If Kindred R Lamb's Respite is activated, enter the zone to survive, then use Kha'Zix R Void Assault to break vision and prepare for your next entry.
Kindred.build: Build armor first against the physical damage from Kindred Q Dance of Arrows and Kindred E Mounting Dread. If Kindred W Wolf's Frenzy and Kindred R Lamb's Respite healing prolong the duel, fit Executioner's Calling between core items.
Kindred.combo: From a spot out of vision, activate Kha'Zix P Unseen Threat, then close in with Kha'Zix E Leap and, immediately on landing, attack in this order: Kha'Zix Q Taste Their Fear → empowered basic attack → Kha'Zix W Void Spike. If Kindred survives, use Kha'Zix R Void Assault to break vision, move to the side, then follow with an empowered basic attack → Kha'Zix Q Taste Their Fear.
Kindred.escape: Don’t rush in when only Kindred Q Dance of Arrows is down, since Kindred W Wolf's Frenzy can also help Kindred escape. In particular, before Kindred W Wolf's Frenzy comes back up, confirm the isolation mark, then close the distance with Kha'Zix E Leap.
Kindred.fight: Fight when Kindred is alone and has an isolation mark, and Kindred W Wolf's Frenzy is still on cooldown. Kindred often uses Kindred Q Dance of Arrows inside Kindred W Wolf's Frenzy, so use Kha'Zix R Void Assault to break vision and find an angle to attack again.
Kindred.laning: Slow Kindred P Mark of the Kindred's growth by taking marked jungle camps first or securing vision nearby. If you can track the enemy jungler's route, target Kindred while they clear a camp alone, or take camps on the opposite side and leave.
Kindred.phase: Early on, Kha'Zix should focus on camps and vision instead of forcing fights, while disrupting Kindred P Mark of the Kindred stacks. Later, when the enemy groups up, Kha'Zix has fewer chances to isolate a target, so look for someone split off.
Kindred.watch: If Kindred E Mounting Dread is applied, use Kha'Zix R Void Assault to break vision or create distance so you don’t get hit by repeated attacks. The lower your health, the greater the danger, so don’t stay in Kindred W Wolf's Frenzy while marked.

MonkeyKing.teamfight: While Wukong R Cyclone is ready, spread out from allies and don’t approach from the front. After Wukong R Cyclone is down, target an isolated damage dealer from a flank or behind. After entering, use Kha'Zix R Void Assault to break vision, disengage, then go back in.
MonkeyKing.watch: Wukong E Nimbus Strike is targeted, so you can’t dodge it; wait outside its range. When Wukong W Warrior Trickster appears, don’t use abilities on the clone left in place; watch the direction the real Wukong escapes. Wukong R Cyclone can knock up multiple people and be used again, so spread out from allies while it is ready.
MonkeyKing.build: Build armor first against Wukong’s main damage. Wukong Q Crushing Blow reduces armor, and Wukong R Cyclone deals damage based on max health, so avoid stacking health alone. If Wukong’s healing offsets your assassination damage, fit Executioner's Calling between core items.
MonkeyKing.combo: When Wukong W Warrior Trickster is down and the real Wukong has an isolation mark, use a bush or Kha'Zix R Void Assault to break vision and prepare Kha'Zix P Unseen Threat. Close in with Kha'Zix E Leap and, immediately on landing, use Kha'Zix Q Taste Their Fear → empowered basic attack → Kha'Zix W Void Spike, in that order. If the fight continues, use Kha'Zix R Void Assault to move to the side and refresh your passive, then use an empowered basic attack → Kha'Zix Q Taste Their Fear.
MonkeyKing.escape: Don’t rush in when only Wukong W Warrior Trickster is down, since Wukong E Nimbus Strike can still help him escape. After entering, use Kha'Zix R Void Assault to break vision and change position.
MonkeyKing.fight: Wukong builds armor and healing the longer the fight continues, so deal damage briefly and then disengage. Close the distance with Kha'Zix E Leap when both Wukong W Warrior Trickster and Wukong E Nimbus Strike are down and you can chase the real Wukong. Confirm the isolation mark, then focus damage with Kha'Zix Q Taste Their Fear.
MonkeyKing.laning: When ganking, route toward the side where the enemy is away from the wave and isolated, and look for an angle from behind a wall. Save Kha'Zix E Leap so you can follow the enemy’s movement or escape.
MonkeyKing.phase: Later, when the enemy groups up and there are fewer isolated targets, focus on finding someone split off.

XinZhao.teamfight: Don’t go in from the front; wait on the flank or behind for an isolated backline damage dealer. Engage after Xin Zhao Q Three Talon Strike and Xin Zhao R Crescent Guard are down, then break vision with Kha'Zix R Void Assault to go in again. Xin Zhao R Crescent Guard’s knockback can split your formation, so don’t stand right next to your allies.
XinZhao.build: Xin Zhao P Determination’s healing can offset your assassination damage, so buy Executioner's Calling between core items. Xin Zhao’s main damage is physical, so build armor first. Armor can’t reduce the magic damage from Xin Zhao E Audacious Charge.
XinZhao.combo: Set up Kha'Zix P Unseen Threat where vision is broken or with the stealth from Kha'Zix R Void Assault. Check for Xin Zhao’s isolation mark, then close in with Kha'Zix E Leap and immediately on landing attack in this order: Kha'Zix Q Taste Their Fear → empowered basic attack → Kha'Zix W Void Spike. If you broke vision with Kha'Zix R Void Assault during the fight, move to the side and follow with an empowered basic attack → Kha'Zix Q Taste Their Fear.
XinZhao.escape: The window to go in with Kha'Zix E Leap is right after Xin Zhao E Audacious Charge. If Xin Zhao Q Three Talon Strike’s third hit and Xin Zhao R Crescent Guard are still available, first check whether they are used. If Xin Zhao Q Three Talon Strike’s third hit is imminent, don’t continue the engage; escape with Kha'Zix E Leap.
XinZhao.fight: Start a fight when Xin Zhao is in a position where an isolation mark appears. Dodge the stab from Xin Zhao W Wind Becomes Lightning to the side, then close the distance with Kha'Zix E Leap right after Xin Zhao E Audacious Charge. If Xin Zhao R Crescent Guard is active, create distance and wait it out before attacking again.
XinZhao.laning: If Xin Zhao is clearing a camp alone with no nearby units and you can read his route, check whether he is isolated and approach. For ganks, walk in and slow the target with Kha'Zix W Void Spike; save Kha'Zix E Leap to chase or escape.
XinZhao.phase: In the late game, grouping leaves fewer isolated targets, so look for enemies who split off. In teamfights, look for the moment Xin Zhao R Crescent Guard ends.
XinZhao.watch: Dodge the follow-up thrust from Xin Zhao W Wind Becomes Lightning by moving to the side. If you’ve been hit twice by Xin Zhao Q Three Talon Strike’s empowered basic attacks, get out of range with Kha'Zix E Leap before the third hit knocks you up. While Xin Zhao R Crescent Guard is active, damage won’t affect him from outside spear range, so wait for it to end.

Hecarim.watch: Hecarim E Devastating Charge deals more damage and knocks you back farther the farther he has run, so when he turns and starts charging, break vision or move toward your allies. Hecarim R Onslaught of Shadows can fear multiple enemies, so don't group up and be ready to dodge it with Kha'Zix E Leap.
Hecarim.build: Build armor first to defend against the physical damage from Hecarim Q Rampage and E Devastating Charge. Hecarim W Spirit of Dread can heal enough to offset your burst, so fit Executioner's Calling between core items.
Hecarim.combo: When Hecarim's mobility ability is down and the isolation marker is visible, use a bush or Kha'Zix R Void Assault to break vision and prepare Kha'Zix P Unseen Threat. Then use Kha'Zix R Void Assault to break vision and move to the side, then attack again with an empowered basic attack → Kha'Zix Q Taste Their Fear.
Hecarim.escape: Don't rush in when only Hecarim E Devastating Charge is down, since Hecarim can escape with Hecarim R Onslaught of Shadows. Close the gap with Kha'Zix E Leap after both Hecarim E Devastating Charge and R Onslaught of Shadows are down, especially before R Onslaught of Shadows comes back up.
Hecarim.fight: Fight Hecarim when he's alone and the isolation marker is visible. Once the fight starts, use the slow from Kha'Zix R Void Assault to reduce Hecarim's movement speed, limiting his ability to approach and deal damage.
Hecarim.laning: Early on, spend time clearing camps and securing vision instead of forcing fights. When ganking, target someone separated from the wave, and save Kha'Zix E Leap for chasing or escaping.
Hecarim.phase: In the late game, it's hard to find an isolated target when the enemy groups up, so look for a chance to catch a separated Hecarim or another opponent.
Hecarim.teamfight: Spread out so multiple allies don't get caught by Hecarim R Onslaught of Shadows, and wait on a flank or behind instead of approaching head-on. Engage when Hecarim E Devastating Charge and R Onslaught of Shadows are down and a backline damage dealer has separated from the formation. After attacking, use Kha'Zix R Void Assault to break vision, disengage, and then re-engage.

Vi.fight: Right after dodging Vi Q Vault Breaker, check for an isolation mark with no nearby allied units, then close in with Kha'Zix E Leap. Deal quick damage with Kha'Zix Q Taste Their Fear, then create distance before Vi W Denting Blows stacks. If Vi P Blast Shield is active, wait until it has been stripped.
Vi.build: Buy armor first to reduce the physical damage from Vi Q Vault Breaker, W Denting Blows, and E Relentless Force. Vi W Denting Blows deals damage based on your maximum health, so avoid stacking health alone. Consider lowering Vi’s attack speed so you don’t take as many basic attacks over time.
Vi.combo: When Vi Q Vault Breaker is down and you see an isolation mark, break vision with a brush or Kha'Zix R Void Assault to activate Kha'Zix P Unseen Threat. Close in with Kha'Zix E Leap, then immediately on landing use Kha'Zix Q Taste Their Fear → empowered basic attack → Kha'Zix W Void Spike. If the fight continues, break vision again with Kha'Zix R Void Assault, move to the side, then follow with an empowered basic attack → Kha'Zix Q Taste Their Fear.
Vi.escape: The window to go in with Kha'Zix E Leap is right after you bait out and dodge Vi Q Vault Breaker. Delay your engage if Vi R Cease and Desist is still available; in teamfights, go in after Vi Q Vault Breaker and R Cease and Desist are down. After engaging, break vision with Kha'Zix R Void Assault to create distance.
Vi.laning: Look for opportunities when the enemy steps ahead of the wave and becomes isolated, or when Vi is clearing a camp alone. For ganks, approach with Kha'Zix W Void Spike and save Kha'Zix E Leap to chase or disengage.
Vi.phase: Kha'Zix is strong in the mid game as he gains two or more evolutions, so look for isolated Vi. In the late game, grouped enemies make it harder to find isolated targets, so create opportunities to catch enemies who split off.
Vi.teamfight: Don’t go in from the front. Wait on the flank or behind for Vi Q Vault Breaker and R Cease and Desist to be used. Engage when a backline damage dealer becomes isolated away from the formation, then break vision with Kha'Zix R Void Assault before going in again.
Vi.watch: When Vi charges Q Vault Breaker, move backward or to the side to dodge it. Vi R Cease and Desist follows its target until it knocks them up, so don’t try to dodge it with Flash; move after the landing animation ends. Extended fights favor Vi because of Vi W Denting Blows.

Ekko.build: Ekko R Chronobreak’s healing can offset your assassination damage, so buy Executioner's Calling between your core items. Build magic resistance rather than armor against Ekko’s main damage.
Ekko.combo: If Ekko is isolated and Ekko W Parallel Convergence and Ekko R Chronobreak are down, activate Kha'Zix P Unseen Threat where vision is broken, then close in with Kha'Zix E Leap. Attack as soon as you land with Kha'Zix Q Taste Their Fear → empowered basic attack → Kha'Zix W Void Spike. If the fight continues, break vision with Kha'Zix R Void Assault, move to the side, then use an empowered basic attack → Kha'Zix Q Taste Their Fear.
Ekko.escape: Avoid the stun area of Ekko W Parallel Convergence and go in during the window when Ekko R Chronobreak is down. If Ekko E Phase Dive is down too, you have a chance to close the gap with Kha'Zix E Leap. If you used Kha'Zix E Leap to go in, use Kha'Zix R Void Assault to escape and re-enter.
Ekko.laning: Early on, spend time on camps and vision instead of forcing fights. Look for a position where Ekko is away from the wave or other units and has an isolation mark. When ganking, walk in and slow him with Kha'Zix W Void Spike, saving Kha'Zix E Leap for chasing or escaping.
Ekko.phase: Mid game, when you have two or more evolutions, is Kha'Zix’s peak. Look for an isolated Ekko when Ekko R Chronobreak is down. Late game, it becomes harder to find isolated targets if the enemy team groups up, so create an angle to catch someone who has split off.
Ekko.teamfight: Don’t go in head-on; wait for an isolated target on the flank or behind the enemy. Go in after Ekko W Parallel Convergence is down, and use Kha'Zix R Void Assault to break vision, escape, and go back in.
Ekko.watch: Ekko W Parallel Convergence stuns and shields him, so stay out of the area where you see its cast indicator. Move out of the path of Ekko Q Timewinder as it returns. If you see Ekko’s afterimage, assume Ekko R Chronobreak is ready, and don’t chase just because he has low health.
Ekko.fight: Target Ekko when the isolation mark appears, but leave the area if you see the signal for Ekko W Parallel Convergence. If only Ekko E Phase Dive is down, he can escape with Ekko R Chronobreak, so use the window before Ekko R Chronobreak comes back up to engage.

Elise.build: Elise P Spider Queen’s healing can offset your assassination damage, so fit Executioner's Calling between your core items. Build magic resistance first against damage from Elise’s main abilities, and add armor if you need to withstand her basic attacks.
Elise.combo: Get out of vision in a brush or with Kha'Zix R Void Assault, then close in with Kha'Zix E Leap and attack as soon as you land with Q Taste Their Fear → empowered basic attack → W Void Spike. If the fight continues, use Kha'Zix R Void Assault to move to the side, then use an empowered basic attack → Q Taste Their Fear again.
Elise.escape: Confirm that both Elise E Cocoon / Rappel’s Cocoon and Elise E Rappel are down before going in. There is also an opportunity to close the gap with Kha'Zix E Leap immediately after Elise uses Elise Q Neurotoxin / Venomous Bite.
Elise.fight: Fight with Kha'Zix Q Taste Their Fear when there are no other units around Elise and she has an isolation mark. After Elise E Cocoon / Rappel is down, approach from outside vision. During the fight, break vision with Kha'Zix R Void Assault to ready an empowered basic attack again.
Elise.laning: Early on, secure vision so Elise can’t get a kill with a gank. If Elise is missing, don’t push the lane recklessly.
Elise.phase: Early on, watch out for Elise, who looks for an advantage with ganks, while Kha'Zix focuses on scaling instead of forcing fights. If the enemy team groups up late game, there will be fewer isolated targets, so look for someone who has split off.
Elise.teamfight: Don’t go in head-on; wait on the flank or behind the enemy for Elise E Cocoon / Rappel to be used. Go in when a backline damage dealer has split from the formation, and after attacking, break vision with Kha'Zix R Void Assault before going back in.
Elise.watch: If Elise E Cocoon / Rappel’s Cocoon hits you, it stuns you and lets Elise engage in R Spider Form, so dodge it with a minion or jungle monster between you. If Elise transforms with Elise R Spider Form after you have lost health, she is looking to finish you off, so create distance with Kha'Zix E Leap or Kha'Zix R Void Assault.

JarvanIV.combo: If the fight continues, use Kha'Zix R Void Assault to break vision again and move to the side, then follow up with an empowered basic attack → Kha'Zix Q Taste Their Fear.
JarvanIV.laning: When ganking, check for the isolation marker, and save Kha'Zix E Leap to follow the target's Flash or escape.
JarvanIV.teamfight: Don't engage head-on; wait on a flank or behind. After attacking, use Kha'Zix R Void Assault to break vision, disengage, and then re-engage.

Karthus.combo: Use a bush or Kha'Zix R Void Assault to break vision and activate Kha'Zix P Unseen Threat. Check for the isolation marker, close in with Kha'Zix E Leap, and immediately upon landing attack in this order: Kha'Zix Q Taste Their Fear → empowered basic attack → Kha'Zix W Void Spike. If Karthus is alive and there's an angle to re-engage, use Kha'Zix R Void Assault to move to the side, then follow up with an empowered basic attack → Kha'Zix Q Taste Their Fear.
Karthus.escape: Karthus has no mobility or immobilizing abilities, so engage when the isolation marker appears and there's a path around Karthus W Wall of Pain. If the wall is cast, use Kha'Zix E Leap or Kha'Zix R Void Assault to take a path around the wall. When you get the kill, move away from the corpse to avoid the lingering attacks from Karthus P Death Defied.
Karthus.fight: Karthus has no mobility ability to create distance, so look for an isolated target with the isolation marker. Activate Kha'Zix P Unseen Threat from out of vision, close in with Kha'Zix E Leap, and combine its landing damage with Kha'Zix Q Taste Their Fear. If Karthus W Wall of Pain is cast, don't cross it; use Kha'Zix R Void Assault to break vision and reposition.
Karthus.laning: However, avoid forcing fights before Kha'Zix's first evolution too, and focus on camps and vision. For ganks, walk in and slow the target with Kha'Zix W Void Spike, saving Kha'Zix E Leap for chasing or escaping.
Karthus.phase: In the late game, the enemy has fewer isolated targets when grouped up, so look for an opportunity to catch a separated Karthus.
Karthus.teamfight: Don't engage head-on. Wait on a flank for Karthus to separate from the formation and become isolated. After engaging, use Kha'Zix R Void Assault to break vision and reposition. Even if you kill Karthus, don't stay near his corpse until Karthus P Death Defied ends. After the fight, keep enough health to survive Karthus R Requiem.
Karthus.watch: Crossing Karthus W Wall of Pain reduces your magic resistance and slows you, making the following Karthus Q Lay Waste and Karthus R Requiem more dangerous. Go around the wall and walk out of the telegraphed area for Karthus Q Lay Waste. Because of Karthus P Death Defied, he can still use Karthus Q Lay Waste and Karthus E Defile immediately after being killed, so move away from his corpse at once.

Nunu.build: Nunu & Willump Q Consume healing can offset your assassination damage, so buy Executioner's Calling between core items. Prioritize magic resistance against Nunu & Willump’s main damage, and build tenacity too if the snowball crowd control is a problem.
Nunu.combo: If Nunu & Willump is isolated and has used crowd control, use a bush or Kha'Zix R Void Assault to break vision and activate Kha'Zix P Unseen Threat. Close in with Kha'Zix E Leap and, immediately on landing, use Kha'Zix Q Taste Their Fear → empowered basic attack → Kha'Zix W Void Spike, in that order. If you can keep fighting, use Kha'Zix R Void Assault to break vision again, move to the side, then follow with an empowered basic attack → Kha'Zix Q Taste Their Fear.
Nunu.escape: After Nunu & Willump W Biggest Snowball Ever! and E Snowball Barrage are down is Kha'Zix’s chance to engage. Nunu & Willump has no ability to create distance on their own, so if you confirm the isolation mark, close the distance with Kha'Zix E Leap. If you used Kha'Zix E Leap to engage, use Kha'Zix R Void Assault to break vision and find an escape route.
Nunu.fight: Deal damage with Kha'Zix Q Taste Their Fear when Nunu & Willump is alone and has an isolation mark. Don’t rush to finish them when they are near a target they can heal from with Nunu & Willump Q Consume. Engage after dodging Nunu & Willump W Biggest Snowball Ever! and E Snowball Barrage.
Nunu.laning: Nunu & Willump can return soon even after you dodge one gank, so keep watching routes outside your vision.
Nunu.phase: Mid game, when Kha'Zix has two or more evolutions, is his strongest phase, so look for an isolated enemy. Later, when the enemy groups up, Kha'Zix has fewer isolated targets, so set up an angle to catch an enemy who is split off.
Nunu.teamfight: Don’t try to endure a fight while attacking Nunu & Willump head-on; wait on a flank or behind. Go in after Nunu & Willump W Biggest Snowball Ever! and E Snowball Barrage are down and an enemy backline damage dealer is separated. After entering, use Kha'Zix R Void Assault to break vision, disengage, then go back in; if Nunu & Willump R Absolute Zero starts, leave its area.
Nunu.watch: Nunu & Willump W Biggest Snowball Ever! knocks you up, so move sideways out of its path. If Nunu & Willump E Snowball Barrage hits you, immediately disengage with Kha'Zix E Leap to avoid the root that follows. The longer you stay within Nunu & Willump R Absolute Zero’s range, the harder it is to escape, so leave the area as soon as it is cast.

Poppy.build: Build armor first against Poppy’s main damage from Poppy Q Hammer Shock, Poppy E Heroic Charge, and Poppy R Keeper's Verdict. Poppy Q Hammer Shock deals damage based on max health, so avoid stacking health alone, and don’t spend extra resources on magic resistance just for Poppy.
Poppy.combo: If Poppy W Steadfast Presence has ended and an isolation mark appears, use a bush or Kha'Zix R Void Assault to get out of vision and prepare Kha'Zix P Unseen Threat. Close in with Kha'Zix E Leap, then use Kha'Zix Q Taste Their Fear → empowered basic attack → Kha'Zix W Void Spike without inserting another action. If the fight continues, use Kha'Zix R Void Assault to break vision again, move to the side, then follow with an empowered basic attack → Kha'Zix Q Taste Their Fear.
Poppy.escape: Right after you make Poppy use Poppy E Heroic Charge is your chance to close the distance. Before going in with Kha'Zix E Leap, also confirm that Poppy W Steadfast Presence has ended. In team fights, engage after Poppy E Heroic Charge and Poppy R Keeper's Verdict are down.
Poppy.fight: If Poppy W Steadfast Presence is active, adjust your distance on foot and save Kha'Zix E Leap. After Poppy E Heroic Charge has been used and Poppy W Steadfast Presence has also ended, confirm the isolation mark, close in with Kha'Zix E Leap, and use Kha'Zix Q Taste Their Fear. Poppy gains more armor at lower health, so only go deep when you can secure the finish.
Poppy.laning: Early on, spend time on camps and vision instead of forcing fights, and when ganking, check whether the enemy is away from the wave and has an isolation mark. Fight in open space where it is difficult for Poppy to use a wall to stun you with Poppy E Heroic Charge. When ganking, walk in and slow with Kha'Zix W Void Spike, then save Kha'Zix E Leap to chase or disengage.
Poppy.phase: Mid game, when Kha'Zix has two or more evolutions, is his peak, so target isolated enemies. Later, when the enemy groups up, there are fewer isolated targets, so focus on creating an angle to catch an enemy who is split off.
Poppy.teamfight: Don’t try to endure a fight while attacking Poppy head-on; wait on a flank or behind. Engage after Poppy E Heroic Charge and Poppy R Keeper's Verdict are down and an enemy backline damage dealer is separated from the formation. After entering, use Kha'Zix R Void Assault to break vision, disengage, then go back in.
Poppy.watch: When Poppy W Steadfast Presence is active, going in with Kha'Zix E Leap will block the leap and briefly prevent you from using mobility abilities, so wait until the effect ends. If Poppy E Heroic Charge pushes you into a wall, you’ll be stunned, so don’t stand with your back to one. When you see Poppy R Keeper's Verdict being charged, move sideways out of its path, and if Poppy Q Hammer Shock hits you, walk out of the area before its second explosion.

Rammus.build: Prioritize magic resistance because Rammus Q Powerball, Rammus W Defensive Ball Curl, and Rammus R Soaring Slam deal primarily magic damage. Rammus’s high armor makes him a poor target for Kha'Zix to attack for long, so focus on someone else. If you must attack Rammus, consider percentage penetration over flat penetration.
Rammus.combo: Target someone when Rammus W Defensive Ball Curl ends and the isolation mark appears. From an area without vision, activate Kha'Zix P Unseen Threat, then close in with Kha'Zix E Leap and, as soon as you land, attack in this order: Kha'Zix Q Taste Their Fear → empowered basic attack → Kha'Zix W Void Spike. If the fight continues, use Kha'Zix R Void Assault to break vision, move sideways, then follow up with an empowered basic attack → Kha'Zix Q Taste Their Fear.
Rammus.escape: Rammus E Frenzying Taunt prevents movement and ability use, so engage after the taunt is down. If Rammus Q Powerball and Rammus R Soaring Slam are down too, that’s an opportunity to close in with Kha'Zix E Leap.
