Rammus R Soaring Slam leaves ongoing aftershocks where it lands, so leave the area immediately.
Rammus.fight: Don’t commit your burst while Rammus W Defensive Ball Curl is active; wait for it to end. Stay outside Rammus E Frenzying Taunt’s range, then target someone once Rammus’s crowd control is down and the isolation mark appears. After engaging, use Kha'Zix R Void Assault to break vision and create another opening to attack.
Rammus.laning: Keep minions between you and Rammus Q Powerball’s path before he rolls in. When ganking, check whether the enemy is away from the wave and has the isolation mark.
Rammus.phase: In the late game, when the enemy team groups up and it’s hard to isolate a target, look for a chance to catch enemies who have split off instead of taking a direct team fight.
Rammus.teamfight: Don’t attack Rammus from the front; wait for an isolated damage dealer from the side or behind. Go in after Rammus Q Powerball, Rammus E Frenzying Taunt, and Rammus R Soaring Slam are down, and don’t attack Rammus while Rammus W Defensive Ball Curl is active. After engaging, use Kha'Zix R Void Assault to break vision, leave, and then go back in.
Rammus.watch: When you see Rammus Q Powerball rolling toward you, keep minions between you and him, and move well clear of the expected area of Rammus R Soaring Slam. Rammus E Frenzying Taunt can’t be dodged once you’re in range, so use Kha'Zix E Leap or Kha'Zix R Void Assault before you’re taunted. When Rammus W Defensive Ball Curl is active, stop attacking to avoid the reflected damage from basic attacks.

Sejuani.build: Choose a first defensive item with magic resistance. It helps against the damage from Sejuani P Fury of the North, Sejuani Q Arctic Assault, and Sejuani E Permafrost, but magic resistance cannot block damage from Sejuani W Winter's Wrath. Sejuani P Fury of the North deals damage based on maximum health, so avoid relying on stacking health alone.
Sejuani.combo: If Sejuani is isolated and has used Sejuani Q Arctic Assault, activate Kha'Zix P Unseen Threat from an area without vision and close in with Kha'Zix E Leap. As soon as you land, use Kha'Zix Q Taste Their Fear → empowered basic attack → Kha'Zix W Void Spike. If the fight continues, use Kha'Zix R Void Assault to break vision, move sideways, then follow up with an empowered basic attack → Kha'Zix Q Taste Their Fear.
Sejuani.escape: The window to engage with Kha'Zix E Leap is right after you bait out Sejuani Q Arctic Assault. Wait to engage if Sejuani Q Arctic Assault, Sejuani E Permafrost, or Sejuani R Glacial Prison is still available. After going in, use Kha'Zix R Void Assault to break vision and reposition.
Sejuani.fight: Check for the isolation mark before fighting. Bait out Sejuani Q Arctic Assault, then close the gap with Kha'Zix E Leap, but retreat if Sejuani E Permafrost stacks build up. If Sejuani’s Frost Armor is active, damage her first to give it time to wear off and remove her slow immunity.
Sejuani.laning: Path toward Sejuani when she’s clearing camps alone or toward an enemy laner who has moved ahead of the wave and is isolated. When ganking, walk in and slow them with Kha'Zix W Void Spike, saving Kha'Zix E Leap to follow their escape or get out.
Sejuani.phase: Early on, prioritize camps and vision over forcing fights as Kha'Zix, but look for opportunities to take initiative when Sejuani is alone. In the late game, if the enemy team groups up and there are no isolated targets, look for a chance to catch enemies who have split off instead of taking a direct team fight.
Sejuani.teamfight: Don’t try to endure a fight by attacking Sejuani from the front; wait for an isolated damage dealer from the side or behind. Engage after Sejuani Q Arctic Assault, Sejuani E Permafrost, and Sejuani R Glacial Prison are down. After engaging, use Kha'Zix R Void Assault to break vision, leave, and then go back in.
Sejuani.watch: Dodge Sejuani Q Arctic Assault and Sejuani R Glacial Prison by watching their windups and moving sideways. If you’re hit by the first strike of Sejuani W Winter's Wrath, move out of range before the second strike. Sejuani E Permafrost stacks can build from basic attacks by melee allies too, so immediately create distance when the indicator starts filling.

Shyvana.build: Prioritize magic resistance against Shyvana W Inferno Aegis, Shyvana E Molten Burst, and Shyvana R Dragon's Descent, and also get armor against her basic attacks. If Shyvana’s healing offsets your assassination damage, buy Executioner's Calling between core items.
Shyvana.combo: When Shyvana is isolated, activate Kha'Zix P Unseen Threat from an area without vision, then time Kha'Zix E Leap’s landing with Kha'Zix Q Taste Their Fear. Follow immediately with an empowered basic attack and Kha'Zix W Void Spike. If the fight continues, use Kha'Zix R Void Assault to break vision, move sideways, then use an empowered basic attack and Kha'Zix Q Taste Their Fear again.
Shyvana.escape: Look to engage when Shyvana R Dragon's Descent is down and her Fury bar is empty. If she’s dashing with Shyvana R Dragon's Descent, dodge the landing, check for the isolation mark and your distance, then close in with Kha'Zix E Leap.
Shyvana.fight: Look for a fight when Shyvana’s Fury bar is empty or she has just returned from Dragon Form. Use Kha'Zix Q Taste Their Fear on an isolated Shyvana, and if she tries to stay close and fight, create distance again with Kha'Zix E Leap or Kha'Zix R Void Assault.
Shyvana.laning: Before your first evolution, avoid forcing fights; secure camps and vision while looking for chances to take Shyvana’s early camps and objectives. When ganking, check for the isolation mark and walk in, saving Kha'Zix E Leap to chase or escape.
Shyvana.phase: Kha'Zix is strong in the mid game as he gets his second or later evolution, so target an isolated Shyvana. In the late game, Shyvana’s permanent stacks build up, and it’s hard to make use of Kha'Zix’s isolation damage against a grouped enemy team, so look for a split target.
Shyvana.teamfight: Spread out so Shyvana R Dragon's Descent’s path, Shyvana W Inferno Aegis, and Shyvana E Molten Burst don’t hit multiple players. Kha'Zix shouldn’t try to endure a fight by attacking Shyvana from the front; wait for an isolated backline target from the side. After engaging, use Kha'Zix R Void Assault to break vision and go back in.
Shyvana.watch: Shyvana Q Emberstrike empowers her basic attack while she’s close and deals damage based on maximum health as well as true damage. If you’re slowed by Shyvana E Molten Burst, it’s hard to create distance, so save Kha'Zix E Leap when Shyvana approaches. Shyvana R Dragon's Descent is unstoppable while she flies in, so avoid her landing point.

Skarner.build: Decide early whether to build Quicksilver Sash or Mercurial Scimitar to deal with the suppression from Skarner R Impale. Build magic resistance against the magic damage from Skarner P Threads of Vibration, Skarner W Seismic Bastion, and Skarner R Impale. Skarner P Threads of Vibration and Skarner Q Shattered Earth / Upheaval deal damage based on maximum health, so don’t rely on stacking health alone.
Skarner.combo: When Skarner E Ixtal's Impact is down and the isolation mark is visible, prepare Kha'Zix P Unseen Threat from an area without vision. Close in with Kha'Zix E Leap and, as soon as you land, attack in this order: Kha'Zix Q Taste Their Fear → empowered basic attack → Kha'Zix W Void Spike. If you can keep fighting, use Kha'Zix R Void Assault to break vision, move sideways, then attack again with an empowered basic attack → Kha'Zix Q Taste Their Fear.
Skarner.escape: The chance to close the gap with Kha'Zix E Leap comes right after you bait out Skarner E Ixtal's Impact. If Skarner R Impale is still available, be careful approaching because Kha'Zix E Leap can’t remove its suppression. If Skarner E Ixtal's Impact also knocks you into a wall, retreat while accounting for his next dash.
Skarner.fight: Target someone right after Skarner uses Skarner E Ixtal's Impact, when the isolation mark appears. Skarner W Seismic Bastion grants a shield, and it’s dangerous to stay close and get hit by empowered basic attacks from Skarner Q Shattered Earth / Upheaval, so don’t try to fight Skarner for long. After engaging, use Kha'Zix R Void Assault to break vision and prepare Kha'Zix P Unseen Threat again.
Skarner.laning: If you can read Skarner’s pathing, look for when he’s clearing camps alone or take camps on the opposite side and leave. Use early jungle pressure and objectives to delay Skarner’s item timings. When ganking, set up from behind a wall, but avoid spots where Skarner E Ixtal's Impact can knock you into one.
Skarner.phase: In the late game, it gets harder to find isolated targets when the enemy team groups up, so focus on chances to catch enemies who have split off.
Skarner.teamfight: Don’t try to endure a fight by attacking Skarner from the front; wait for a damage dealer who has split off from the side or behind. Engage after Skarner E Ixtal's Impact and Skarner R Impale are down, then use Kha'Zix R Void Assault to break vision, leave, and go back in. Don’t stand against a wall at the edge of the Dragon or Baron pit, where Skarner R Impale can pull you in.
Skarner.watch: Skarner E Ixtal's Impact dashes through terrain and stuns you if you hit a wall, so don’t stand with your back to one. You can’t escape suppression from Skarner R Impale with Kha'Zix E Leap, so keep your distance when Skarner approaches. Move outside melee range to avoid repeated empowered basic attacks from Skarner Q Shattered Earth / Upheaval.

Taliyah.build: Build magic resistance first to reduce the magic damage from Taliyah Q Threaded Volley and Taliyah E Unraveled Earth. Since Kha'Zix can adjust his engage angle with Kha'Zix E Leap, don’t automatically follow the usual priority of tenacity for champions without mobility.
Taliyah.combo: Activate Kha'Zix P Unseen Threat where vision is broken, then use Kha'Zix E Leap from an angle without a field of rocks. Immediately on landing, attack in this order: Kha'Zix Q Taste Their Fear → empowered basic attack → Kha'Zix W Void Spike. Don’t use another action between Leap and Q. If the fight continues, break vision with Kha'Zix R Void Assault, move to the side, then attack again with an empowered basic attack → Kha'Zix Q Taste Their Fear.
Taliyah.escape: Engage after Taliyah W Seismic Shove and Taliyah E Unraveled Earth are down, and change Kha'Zix E Leap’s path if a field of rocks remains. Don’t chase just because one of Taliyah’s movement options is down; check Taliyah R Weaver's Wall too. In particular, close the distance with Kha'Zix E Leap when Taliyah R Weaver's Wall is down and you see an isolation mark.
Taliyah.fight: Check for an isolation mark, and fight when Taliyah is away from allied units or jungle monsters. Kha'Zix’s physical damage is effective against Taliyah’s low armor, so approach from out of vision and concentrate damage quickly. For ganks, slow her with Kha'Zix W Void Spike before approaching, and save Kha'Zix E Leap to chase or disengage.
Taliyah.laning: Taliyah isn’t isolated while she is near minions, so look for when she steps ahead of the wave. Set up a gank from behind a wall instead of using the warded river path. If Taliyah goes missing in the jungle, anticipate her using Taliyah P Rock Surfing and Taliyah R Weaver's Wall to affect another lane, and fall back early.
Taliyah.phase: Kha'Zix peaks in the mid game as he gains two or more evolutions, so look for Taliyah when she is moving alone. In the late game, grouping leaves fewer isolated targets, so create opportunities to catch enemies who split off.
Taliyah.teamfight: Don’t go in from the front; wait on the flank or behind for Taliyah to separate from her formation. Engage when Taliyah W Seismic Shove, E Unraveled Earth, and R Weaver's Wall are down and you see an isolation mark. After attacking, break vision with Kha'Zix R Void Assault, leave, and look for a chance to go in again.
Taliyah.watch: When Taliyah E Unraveled Earth is laid down, don’t Leap over it with Kha'Zix E Leap. Taliyah Q Threaded Volley can’t change direction while being cast, so dodge to the side instead of running straight away.

Udyr.build: If healing from Udyr W Iron Mantle prevents an assassination, buy Executioner's Calling between core items. Prioritize armor when building resistances. However, Udyr R Wingborne Storm deals magic damage, and Udyr Q Wilding Claw deals both damage types, so armor alone won’t block all of it.
Udyr.combo: When Udyr E Blazing Stampede is down and the isolation mark is visible, break vision in brush or with Kha'Zix R Void Assault to prepare Kha'Zix P Unseen Threat. Close in with Kha'Zix E Leap and, as soon as you land, use Kha'Zix Q Taste Their Fear → empowered basic attack → Kha'Zix W Void Spike. If the fight continues, use Kha'Zix R Void Assault to break vision again, move sideways, then follow up with an empowered basic attack → Kha'Zix Q Taste Their Fear.
Udyr.escape: The window to close the gap with Kha'Zix E Leap is right after you bait out Udyr E Blazing Stampede. If Udyr E Blazing Stampede stuns you once, Udyr can’t stun the same target again for a while; use that time to fight back or escape. Udyr is hard to outrun on foot, so consider saving Kha'Zix E Leap or Kha'Zix R Void Assault for when you need to get away.
Udyr.fight: Engage when Udyr E Blazing Stampede is down and the isolation mark is visible. Once Udyr W Iron Mantle’s shield is gone, burst him with Kha'Zix Q Taste Their Fear and empowered basic attacks to give him less time to heal. Don’t force a fight if units nearby keep Udyr from being isolated.
Udyr.laning: Place vision at jungle chokepoints and entrances to track Udyr’s pathing. Gank from behind a wall, targeting enemies who are away from their wave. If an enemy is near allied minions, they aren’t isolated, weakening Kha'Zix Q Taste Their Fear’s kill threat.
Udyr.phase: Kha'Zix peaks in the mid game as he gets his second or later evolution, so target an isolated Udyr or someone else. In the late game, isolated targets become less common when the enemy team groups up, so look for a chance to catch someone who has split off.
Udyr.teamfight: Don’t attack the tanky Udyr from the front; wait from the side or behind. Engage after Udyr E Blazing Stampede is down and a vulnerable enemy in the backline has split from formation. After a kill, use Kha'Zix R Void Assault to break vision and leave, then look for another chance to go in.
Udyr.watch: When Udyr E Blazing Stampede is newly activated, watch for the stun on his first attack, and don’t close in first with Kha'Zix E Leap during that time. Udyr Q Wilding Claw and Udyr R Wingborne Storm deal damage based on maximum health, so don’t stay in a prolonged fight. Udyr W Iron Mantle’s shield and healing can withstand Kha'Zix’s burst.

Zac.build: If Zac P Cell Division’s healing offsets your burst damage, buy Executioner's Calling between core items. Build magic resistance rather than armor against Zac Q Stretching Strikes, W Unstable Matter, and E Elastic Slingshot. Zac W Unstable Matter deals damage based on maximum health, so avoid stacking health alone.
Zac.combo: If Zac is isolated and Zac E Elastic Slingshot and Q Stretching Strikes are down, break vision with a brush or Kha'Zix R Void Assault to prepare Kha'Zix P Unseen Threat. Immediately after Kha'Zix E Leap lands, use Q Taste Their Fear → empowered basic attack → W Void Spike. If you need to continue fighting, use Kha'Zix R Void Assault → move to the side → empowered basic attack → Q Taste Their Fear to use your passive again.
Zac.escape: Time your engage for the window when Zac E Elastic Slingshot is down and he can’t move with it. If Zac Q Stretching Strikes is also down, the risk of being knocked up when going in with Kha'Zix E Leap is lower. After weathering Zac’s engage, break vision with Kha'Zix R Void Assault and create distance.
Zac.fight: When Zac is away from allies or jungle monsters and an isolation mark appears, trade damage with Kha'Zix Q Taste Their Fear. Right after Zac E Elastic Slingshot is down, you can close the distance with Kha'Zix E Leap. During the fight, step on the blobs Zac drops to stop his healing. If you’ve weathered his engage, create distance to avoid Zac W Unstable Matter.
Zac.laning: If you can read Zac’s route when he’s clearing a camp alone, check for an isolation mark and look for a fight, or take the camp on the opposite side. For ganks, target someone away from the wave rather than someone near it, and save Kha'Zix E Leap to chase or disengage.
Zac.phase: In the late game, if Zac and his allies group up and there are no isolated targets, Kha'Zix becomes weaker, so create opportunities to catch enemies who split off.
Zac.teamfight: Instead of repeatedly hitting Zac from the front, wait on the flank for Zac Q Stretching Strikes and E Elastic Slingshot to be used. Then engage if an enemy backline damage dealer becomes isolated from the formation.
Zac.watch: Zac E Elastic Slingshot charges before lunging and knocking you up, so if you see him charging behind a wall, avoid the landing area. If you stay close after Zac Q Stretching Strikes slows and knocks you up, you’re likely to take the maximum health damage from Zac W Unstable Matter too. Check before fighting whether Zac P Cell Division is available to revive him.
